atoms.name: div
atoms.rule: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a / b 是向零取整的除法，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain_zh: a @ 把 |a| 的十进制数字倒过来写，再保留 a 的符号。

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain_zh: # a 是带符号三角数 sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2。

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain_zh: a $ 是 |a| 的二进制里 1 的个数。

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain_zh: & a 是 |a| 的各位数字之和，再乘上 a 的符号。

domain.en: Values are integers, and each atom result is reduced modulo 12, so results lie in 0 to 11.
domain.zh: 取值是整数，每个原子结果都对 12 取模，所以结果落在 0 到 11。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms and defaults.
settings.zh: 选择这些原子和默认设置的预设。

settings.en: Every atom result is reduced modulo this number.
settings.zh: 每个原子的结果都对这个数取模。

settings.en: A recursive call reduces its counter modulo a number drawn from this range, so it unfolds fewer times than that number.
settings.zh: 递归计数先对这个范围里抽到的数取模，所以展开次数小于这个数。

settings.en: The range of numbers in generated expressions and branch thresholds.
settings.zh: 生成算式和分支阈值所用的数值范围。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♣₁
operators.plain: Multiply a by a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 乘以 a。

operators.name: ♠₂
operators.definition: ♠₂ a = { a, if a < 6; (♣₁₄ a) % a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 6, return a; otherwise apply ♣₁₄ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6，结果为 a；否则先对 a 应用 ♣₁₄，再求结果除以 a 的余数。

operators.name: □₃
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 4| times: apply △₁₇ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 4| 次：对结果应用 △₁₇。

operators.name: ☆₄
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply ♤₁₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 ♤₁₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ◆₅
operators.plain: Compute 0 ♦₄₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 0 和 a 应用 ♦₄₆。

operators.name: ○₆
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then multiply it by the digit sum of a.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再把结果乘以「a 的数字和」。

operators.name: ♥₇
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then take the remainder when dividing it by ○₆ 6.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再求结果除以 ○₆ 6 的余数。

operators.name: ♡₈
operators.plain: Apply ○₆ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by ○₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₆，再求结果除以 ○₆ b 的余数。

operators.name: ♧₉
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then multiply it by -7.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再把结果乘以 -7。

operators.name: ◆₁₀
operators.plain: Count the one bits of a, then subtract a from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再从结果中减去 a。

operators.name: ♢₁₁
operators.plain: Divide a by ♥₇ a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 除以 ♥₇ a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♢₁₂
operators.plain: Add 0 to a, then sum its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 加上 0，再求结果的各位数字之和。

operators.name: ♧₁₃
operators.plain: Multiply 1 by a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 1 乘以 a。

operators.name: ♣₁₄
operators.plain: Apply ♣₁ to 4, then add ♢₁₂ a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 4 应用 ♣₁，再把结果加上 ♢₁₂ a。

operators.name: ♤₁₅
operators.plain: Subtract 8 from a.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 中减去 8。

operators.name: ○₁₆
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then apply ♡₈ to the result and (♢₁₂ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再对结果和 ♢₁₂ a 应用 ♡₈。

operators.name: △₁₇
operators.plain: Divide a by -a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 除以 -a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♣₁₈
operators.plain: Apply △₁₇ to b, then multiply it by △₁₇ a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 △₁₇，再把结果乘以 △₁₇ a。

operators.name: ▽₁₉
operators.plain: Apply ♣₁ to a, then apply △₁₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♣₁，再对结果应用 △₁₇。

operators.name: ▲₂₀
operators.plain: Apply ♡₈ to a and (-a).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 -a 应用 ♡₈。

operators.name: ○₂₁
operators.definition: a ○₂₁ = { a + (△₁₇ a), if a < 1; (5 * a) ♧₉, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, add △₁₇ a to a; otherwise multiply 5 by a, then apply ♧₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，把 a 加上 △₁₇ a；否则先把 5 乘以 a，再对结果应用 ♧₉。

operators.name: ▼₂₂
operators.definition: a ▼₂₂ = { 4 - a, if a >= 8 and a < 9; a ▽₁₉, if a < 6; a * 3, else }
operators.plain: If 8 ≤ a < 9, subtract a from 4; otherwise if a < 6, apply ▽₁₉ to a; otherwise multiply a by 3.
operators.plain_zh: 若 8 ≤ a < 9，从 4 中减去 a；否则若 a < 6，对 a 应用 ▽₁₉；否则把 a 乘以 3。

operators.name: ♠₂₃
operators.definition: a ♠₂₃ b = { (b ▽₁₉) * (b ▽₁₉), if a >= 4 and b >= 9 and b < 11; (b ♧₉) * a, if a >= 1 and a < 4 and b >= 9 and b < 11; a - b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 4 and b ≥ 9 and b < 11, apply ▽₁₉ to b, then multiply the result by itself; otherwise if 1 ≤ a < 4 and b ≥ 9 and b < 11, apply ♧₉ to b, then multiply it by a; otherwise subtract b from a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 4 且 b ≥ 9 且 b < 11，先对 b 应用 ▽₁₉，再把结果乘以结果；否则若 1 ≤ a < 4 且 b ≥ 9 且 b < 11，先对 b 应用 ♧₉，再把结果乘以 a；否则从 a 中减去 b。

operators.name: ●₂₄
operators.definition: a ●₂₄ = { △₁₇ a, if a >= 4 and a < 8; ○₆ a, else }
operators.plain: If 4 ≤ a < 8, apply △₁₇ to a; otherwise apply ○₆ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 4 ≤ a < 8，对 a 应用 △₁₇；否则对 a 应用 ○₆。

operators.name: ▼₂₅
operators.definition: a ▼₂₅ b = { ♣₁ (& a), if a < 10 and b >= 1 and b < 4; a - (b ▽₁₉), else }
operators.plain: If a < 10 and b ≥ 1 and b < 4, sum the digits of a, then apply ♣₁ to the result; otherwise subtract b ▽₁₉ from a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 10 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 4，先求 a 的各位数字之和，再对结果应用 ♣₁；否则从 a 中减去 b ▽₁₉。

operators.name: ◇₂₆
operators.definition: a ◇₂₆ b = { (○₆ b) * b, if a >= 11 and b >= 11; ♠₂ (a ♣₁₈ 8), if a < 1 and b >= 11; (a @) ○₂₁, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11 and b ≥ 11, apply ○₆ to b, then multiply it by b; otherwise if a < 1 and b ≥ 11, apply ♣₁₈ to a and 8, then apply ♠₂ to the result; otherwise reverse the digits of a, then apply ○₂₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11 且 b ≥ 11，先对 b 应用 ○₆，再把结果乘以 b；否则若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 11，先对 a 和 8 应用 ♣₁₈，再对结果应用 ♠₂；否则先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再对结果应用 ○₂₁。

operators.name: ♣₂₇
operators.definition: a ♣₂₇ = { (2 ♧₁₃) + a, if a < 4; a ♢₁₁, else }
operators.plain: If a < 4, apply ♧₁₃ to 2, then add a to it; otherwise apply ♢₁₁ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 4，先对 2 应用 ♧₁₃，再把结果加上 a；否则对 a 应用 ♢₁₁。

operators.name: ▽₂₈
operators.definition: ▽₂₈ a = { (8 ○₂₁) + (○₆ a), if a >= 11; (♣₁₄ a) ◇₂₆ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11, apply ○₂₁ to 8, then add ○₆ a to it; otherwise apply ♣₁₄ to a, then apply ◇₂₆ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11，先对 8 应用 ○₂₁，再把结果加上 ○₆ a；否则先对 a 应用 ♣₁₄，再对结果和 a 应用 ◇₂₆。

operators.name: ♦₂₉
operators.definition: ♦₂₉ a = { ♠₂ a, if a < 1; (♥₇ a) * (▲₂₀ a), if a >= 9; (◆₁₀ a) ▼₂₅ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, apply ♠₂ to a; otherwise if a ≥ 9, apply ♥₇ to a, then multiply it by ▲₂₀ a; otherwise apply ◆₁₀ to a, then apply ▼₂₅ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，对 a 应用 ♠₂；否则若 a ≥ 9，先对 a 应用 ♥₇，再把结果乘以 ▲₂₀ a；否则先对 a 应用 ◆₁₀，再对结果和 a 应用 ▼₂₅。

operators.name: □₃₀
operators.definition: □₃₀ a = { (- a) % a, if a >= 8 and a < 11; 3 ♡₈ (♢₁₂ a), if a < 0; (♠₂ a) ♠₂₃ a, else }
operators.plain: If 8 ≤ a < 11, negate a, then take the remainder when dividing it by a; otherwise if a < 0, apply ♡₈ to 3 and (♢₁₂ a); otherwise apply ♠₂ to a, then apply ♠₂₃ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 8 ≤ a < 11，先把 a 取相反数，再求结果除以 a 的余数；否则若 a < 0，对 3 和 ♢₁₂ a 应用 ♡₈；否则先对 a 应用 ♠₂，再对结果和 a 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ○₃₁
operators.definition: a ○₃₁ b = { (b ▼₂₂) + (◆₁₀ b), if a >= 9 and b >= 5 and b < 8; (b ▼₂₂) / (b ●₂₄), if a >= 9 and b < 5; (♦₂₉ b) * (b ●₂₄), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9 and b ≥ 5 and b < 8, apply ▼₂₂ to b, then add ◆₁₀ b to it; otherwise if a ≥ 9 and b < 5, apply ▼₂₂ to b, then divide it by b ●₂₄, rounding toward zero; otherwise apply ♦₂₉ to b, then multiply it by b ●₂₄.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 8，先对 b 应用 ▼₂₂，再把结果加上 ◆₁₀ b；否则若 a ≥ 9 且 b < 5，先对 b 应用 ▼₂₂，再把结果除以 b ●₂₄ 并向零取整；否则先对 b 应用 ♦₂₉，再把结果乘以 b ●₂₄。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♥₃₂
operators.plain: Compute a ◇₂₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₂₆。

operators.name: ○₃₃
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₂ to a, then apply ♠₂₃ to the result and (▲₂₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₂₂，再对结果和 ▲₂₀ a 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ♤₃₄
operators.definition: a ♤₃₄ = { (a $) + (a ●₂₄), if a < 0; a ♣₁₈ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 0, count the one bits of a, then add a ●₂₄ to it; otherwise compute a ♣₁₈ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0，先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再把结果加上 a ●₂₄；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♣₁₈。

operators.name: ▲₃₅
operators.definition: ▲₃₅ a = { a * a, if a >= 9; △₁₇ a, if a >= 3 and a < 6; a - a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9, multiply a by a; otherwise if 3 ≤ a < 6, apply △₁₇ to a; otherwise subtract a from a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9，把 a 乘以 a；否则若 3 ≤ a < 6，对 a 应用 △₁₇；否则从 a 中减去 a。

operators.name: ▲₃₆
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₅ to a and 3, then sum its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 3 应用 ▼₂₅，再求结果的各位数字之和。

operators.name: ♣₃₇
operators.plain: Apply ♣₁ to a, then multiply it by b ♧₉.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♣₁，再把结果乘以 b ♧₉。

operators.name: ☆₃₈
operators.plain: Apply ◇₂₆ to a and a, then apply ♦₂₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₂₆，再对结果应用 ♦₂₉。

operators.name: ◇₃₉
operators.definition: a ◇₃₉ b = { b ♡₈ b, if a < 5 and b >= 9; (a @) + (□₃₀ 8), else }
operators.plain: If a < 5 and b ≥ 9, compute b ♡₈ b; otherwise reverse the digits of a, then add □₃₀ 8 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 5 且 b ≥ 9，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ♡₈；否则先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再把结果加上 □₃₀ 8。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: □₄₀
operators.plain: Apply ○₆ to a, then add a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₆，再把结果加上 a。

operators.name: ★₄₁
operators.plain: Compute 3 ♠₂₃ a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 3 和 a 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ★₄₂
operators.definition: a ★₄₂ = { 2 % 5, if a < 0; (a ♣₂₇) + (# a), if a >= 7; (- a) ♣₃₇ 6, else }
operators.plain: If a < 0, take the remainder when dividing 2 by 5; otherwise if a ≥ 7, apply ♣₂₇ to a, then add the signed triangle number of a to it; otherwise negate a, then apply ♣₃₇ to the result and 6.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0，求 2 除以 5 的余数；否则若 a ≥ 7，先对 a 应用 ♣₂₇，再把结果加上「a 的带符号三角数」；否则先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 6 应用 ♣₃₇。

operators.name: ○₄₃
operators.plain: Compute 2 ♠₂₃ a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 2 和 a 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ♥₄₄
operators.plain: Start with 78. Repeat |b % 9| times: apply ○₃₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 78 开始，重复 |b % 9| 次：对结果应用 ○₃₃。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ■₄₅
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 7| times: apply □₄₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 7| 次：对结果应用 □₄₀。

operators.name: ♦₄₆
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 9| times: replace the current value by b ◇₃₉ the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 9| 次：把结果换成 b ◇₃₉ 结果。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ○₄₇
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 8| times: apply ♠₂₃ to the current value and the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 8| 次：把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ♦₄₈
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 7| times: apply ★₄₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 7| 次：对结果应用 ★₄₂。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♥₄₉
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 3: when a % 3 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 3) - 1 (or (a % 3) + 1 when a % 3 < 0), then replace r by a ◇₂₆ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 3 计数：a % 3 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 3) - 1（a % 3 < 0 时用 (a % 3) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ◇₂₆ r。

operators.name: ♢₅₀
operators.plain: Start with -43. Repeat |a % 4| times: count the one bits of the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 -43 开始，重复 |a % 4| 次：数结果的二进制里有几个 1。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ■₅₁
operators.plain: Start with 91. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply □₃₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 91 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 □₃₀。

operators.name: ♢₅₂
operators.plain: Compute a ☆₄ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: ●₅₃
operators.plain: Compute a ♦₄₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♦₄₆。

operators.name: ♡₅₄
operators.plain: Compute a ■₄₅ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₄₅。

operators.name: □₅₅
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₅ to a and (♥₄₉ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ♥₄₉ b 应用 ▼₂₅。

operators.name: ◆₅₆
operators.plain: Apply ☆₄ to a and (5 ♢₅₂).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 5 ♢₅₂ 应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: ♣₅₇
operators.plain: Apply ♢₅₂ to 2, then apply ♠₂₃ to the result and (a ♤₁₅).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 2 应用 ♢₅₂，再对结果和 a ♤₁₅ 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ♥₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ◆₅ to a, then apply ♦₄₆ to the result and (a ◆₅₆).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ◆₅，再对结果和 a ◆₅₆ 应用 ♦₄₆。

operators.name: ▲₅₉
operators.plain: Apply ♥₄₄ to a and (▽₂₈ a).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ▽₂₈ a 应用 ♥₄₄。

operators.name: ■₆₀
operators.plain: Add a ◆₅₆ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 加上 a ◆₅₆。

operators.name: ♠₆₁
operators.plain: Apply ■₅₁ to b, then apply ☆₄ to the result and (♥₄₉ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ■₅₁，再对结果和 ♥₄₉ a 应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: ♤₆₂
operators.plain: Apply ♣₅₇ to a, then apply ♣₁₈ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♣₅₇，再对结果和 a 应用 ♣₁₈。

operators.name: ♡₆₃
operators.plain: Apply ♦₂₉ to a, then apply ☆₄ to the result and (♣₁₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♦₂₉，再对结果和 ♣₁₄ b 应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: ♡₆₄
operators.plain: Compute a □₃ 2.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 2 应用 □₃。

operators.name: ◆₆₅
operators.plain: Apply ★₄₁ to a, then apply ♦₄₈ to the result and (a ■₆₀).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ★₄₁，再对结果和 a ■₆₀ 应用 ♦₄₈。

operators.name: ♣₆₆
operators.definition: a ♣₆₆ = { (△₁₇ a) ♦₄₈ (♥₅₈ a), if a >= 5 and a < 6; (1 ♣₂₇) □₃ (♣₅₇ 0), if a < 0; (a * a) ■₆₀, else }
operators.plain: If 5 ≤ a < 6, apply △₁₇ to a, then apply ♦₄₈ to the result and (♥₅₈ a); otherwise if a < 0, apply ♣₂₇ to 1, then apply □₃ to the result and (♣₅₇ 0); otherwise multiply a by a, then apply ■₆₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 5 ≤ a < 6，先对 a 应用 △₁₇，再对结果和 ♥₅₈ a 应用 ♦₄₈；否则若 a < 0，先对 1 应用 ♣₂₇，再对结果和 ♣₅₇ 0 应用 □₃；否则先把 a 乘以 a，再对结果应用 ■₆₀。

operators.name: ♣₆₇
operators.definition: a ♣₆₇ = { a, if a >= 2 and a < 9; 3 ◆₅₆, else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 9, return a; otherwise apply ◆₅₆ to 3.
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 9，结果为 a；否则对 3 应用 ◆₅₆。

operators.name: ♧₆₈
operators.definition: a ♧₆₈ b = { (3 ○₄₇ b) ○₂₁, if a < 8 and b >= 7 and b < 10; (♢₁₂ a) ○₄₇ (b ♧₉), else }
operators.plain: If a < 8 and b ≥ 7 and b < 10, apply ○₄₇ to 3 and b, then apply ○₂₁ to the result; otherwise apply ♢₁₂ to a, then apply ○₄₇ to the result and (b ♧₉).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 8 且 b ≥ 7 且 b < 10，先对 3 和 b 应用 ○₄₇，再对结果应用 ○₂₁；否则先对 a 应用 ♢₁₂，再对结果和 b ♧₉ 应用 ○₄₇。

operators.name: ♢₆₉
operators.definition: a ♢₆₉ b = { b + a, if a >= 6 and b >= 7; b ♡₅₄, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b ≥ 7, add a to b; otherwise apply ♡₅₄ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 6 且 b ≥ 7，把 b 加上 a；否则对 b 应用 ♡₅₄。

operators.name: ●₇₀
operators.definition: a ●₇₀ = { (5 ▼₂₂) ♡₈ (♣₅₇ 1), if a < 2; # (♣₅₇ a), if a >= 3 and a < 9; ♠₂ (a ♧₆₈ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 2, apply ▼₂₂ to 5, then apply ♡₈ to the result and (♣₅₇ 1); otherwise if 3 ≤ a < 9, apply ♣₅₇ to a, then take its signed triangle number; otherwise apply ♧₆₈ to a and a, then apply ♠₂ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 2，先对 5 应用 ▼₂₂，再对结果和 ♣₅₇ 1 应用 ♡₈；否则若 3 ≤ a < 9，先对 a 应用 ♣₅₇，再求结果的带符号三角数；否则先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₆₈，再对结果应用 ♠₂。

operators.name: ▲₇₁
operators.definition: a ▲₇₁ b = { b, if a < 4 and b >= 0 and b < 10; a, if a >= 4 and a < 9 and b >= 10; (♥₃₂ a) ☆₄ (a ♣₆₆), else }
operators.plain: If a < 4 and b ≥ 0 and b < 10, return b; otherwise if 4 ≤ a < 9 and b ≥ 10, return a; otherwise apply ♥₃₂ to a, then apply ☆₄ to the result and (a ♣₆₆).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 4 且 b ≥ 0 且 b < 10，结果为 b；否则若 4 ≤ a < 9 且 b ≥ 10，结果为 a；否则先对 a 应用 ♥₃₂，再对结果和 a ♣₆₆ 应用 ☆₄。

operators.name: □₇₂
operators.definition: a □₇₂ = { (■₅₁ a) ♣₆₆, if a >= 2 and a < 11; a, if a < 0; (■₅₁ a) ○₄₇ a, else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 11, apply ■₅₁ to a, then apply ♣₆₆ to the result; otherwise if a < 0, return a; otherwise apply ■₅₁ to a, then apply ○₄₇ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 11，先对 a 应用 ■₅₁，再对结果应用 ♣₆₆；否则若 a < 0，结果为 a；否则先对 a 应用 ■₅₁，再对结果和 a 应用 ○₄₇。

operators.name: ▲₇₃
operators.definition: a ▲₇₃ b = { b ◇₃₉ b, if a >= 4 and a < 10 and b >= 6 and b < 11; ♣₅₇ a, else }
operators.plain: If 4 ≤ a < 10 and b ≥ 6 and b < 11, compute b ◇₃₉ b; otherwise apply ♣₅₇ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 4 ≤ a < 10 且 b ≥ 6 且 b < 11，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₃₉；否则对 a 应用 ♣₅₇。

operators.name: □₇₄
operators.definition: a □₇₄ = { ♥₄₉ a, if a < 1; a + a, if a >= 2 and a < 7; 2 ○₄₇ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, apply ♥₄₉ to a; otherwise if 2 ≤ a < 7, add a to a; otherwise compute 2 ○₄₇ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，对 a 应用 ♥₄₉；否则若 2 ≤ a < 7，把 a 加上 a；否则对 2 和 a 应用 ○₄₇。

operators.name: ●₇₅
operators.definition: a ●₇₅ b = { a / 3, if a < 11 and b >= 6; a ♣₆₆, else }
operators.plain: If a < 11 and b ≥ 6, divide a by 3, rounding toward zero; otherwise apply ♣₆₆ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 11 且 b ≥ 6，把 a 除以 3 并向零取整；否则对 a 应用 ♣₆₆。

operators.name: ▼₇₆
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 5: when a % 5 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 5) - 1 (or (a % 5) + 1 when a % 5 < 0), then apply □₅₅ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 5 计数：a % 5 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 5) - 1（a % 5 < 0 时用 (a % 5) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 □₅₅。

operators.name: ♡₇₇
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 6| times: replace the current value by b □₃ the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：把结果换成 b □₃ 结果。

operators.name: ▲₇₈
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 4: when a % 4 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 4) - 1 (or (a % 4) + 1 when a % 4 < 0), then apply ■₅₁ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 4 计数：a % 4 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 4) - 1（a % 4 < 0 时用 (a % 4) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ■₅₁。

operators.name: ♢₇₉
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 4| times: apply ●₅₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 4| 次：对结果应用 ●₅₃。

operators.name: ○₈₀
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 3: when a % 3 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 3) - 1 (or (a % 3) + 1 when a % 3 < 0), then apply ■₆₀ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 3 计数：a % 3 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 3) - 1（a % 3 < 0 时用 (a % 3) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ■₆₀。

operators.name: □₈₁
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 7: when a % 7 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 7) - 1 (or (a % 7) + 1 when a % 7 < 0), then apply ♥₄₉ to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 7 计数：a % 7 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (a % 7) - 1（a % 7 < 0 时用 (a % 7) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 应用 ♥₄₉。

operators.name: ♥₈₂
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply ◆₅₆ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 ◆₅₆。

operators.name: ★₈₃
operators.plain: Apply ▼₇₆ to b, then multiply it by ♠₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ▼₇₆，再把结果乘以 ♠₂ a。

operators.name: ♠₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ◇₃₉ to a and (□₈₁ a).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 □₈₁ a 应用 ◇₃₉。

operators.name: ◆₈₅
operators.plain: Compute a ♢₇₉ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♢₇₉。

operators.name: ♤₈₆
operators.plain: Apply ♥₈₂ to a and b, then apply ◆₈₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₈₂，再对结果应用 ◆₈₅。

operators.name: ▽₈₇
operators.plain: Apply ▲₃₅ to a, then apply ♡₆₃ to the result and (□₈₁ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▲₃₅，再对结果和 □₈₁ b 应用 ♡₆₃。

operators.name: ★₈₈
operators.plain: Apply ♡₇₇ to a and b, then apply ○₈₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₇₇，再对结果应用 ○₈₀。

operators.name: ◆₈₉
operators.plain: Reverse the digits of a, then apply ♥₈₂ to the result and 7.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 的数字倒过来写，再对结果和 7 应用 ♥₈₂。

operators.name: ▽₉₀
operators.plain: Apply ♡₇₇ to a and (○₈₀ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ○₈₀ b 应用 ♡₇₇。

operators.name: ♥₉₁
operators.plain: Apply ▽₈₇ to a and a, then sum its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₈₇，再求结果的各位数字之和。

operators.name: ◆₉₂
operators.plain: Compute a ★₈₈ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ★₈₈。

operators.name: ▽₉₃
operators.plain: Apply ♠₂₃ to a and (a ◆₈₅).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ◆₈₅ 应用 ♠₂₃。

operators.name: ☆₉₄
operators.definition: a ☆₉₄ b = { (○₁₆ a) ○₄₃, if a < 1 and b < 7; (○₁₆ a) ♥₈₂ (△₁₇ b), if a < 1 and b >= 8 and b < 9; ○₆ (5 □₃ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 1 and b < 7, apply ○₁₆ to a, then apply ○₄₃ to the result; otherwise if a < 1 and b ≥ 8 and b < 9, apply ○₁₆ to a, then apply ♥₈₂ to the result and (△₁₇ b); otherwise apply □₃ to 5 and a, then apply ○₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1 且 b < 7，先对 a 应用 ○₁₆，再对结果应用 ○₄₃；否则若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 8 且 b < 9，先对 a 应用 ○₁₆，再对结果和 △₁₇ b 应用 ♥₈₂；否则先对 5 和 a 应用 □₃，再对结果应用 ○₆。

operators.name: ◆₉₅
operators.definition: ◆₉₅ a = { a ★₈₈ a, if a >= 3 and a < 5; a ▽₉₀ 2, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 5, compute a ★₈₈ a; otherwise compute a ▽₉₀ 2.
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 5，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ★₈₈；否则对 a 和 2 应用 ▽₉₀。

operators.name: ■₉₆
operators.definition: a ■₉₆ b = { a ♣₁₈ a, if a < 2 and b >= 7; b ☆₃₈, if a < 2 and b >= 1 and b < 7; a ▽₉₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 2 and b ≥ 7, compute a ♣₁₈ a; otherwise if a < 2 and b ≥ 1 and b < 7, apply ☆₃₈ to b; otherwise compute a ▽₉₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 2 且 b ≥ 7，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♣₁₈；否则若 a < 2 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 7，对 b 应用 ☆₃₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₉₀。

operators.name: ○₉₇
operators.definition: a ○₉₇ = { ◆₉₂ a, if a >= 6; ♠₂ a, if a < 2; a ♣₃₇ 2, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6, apply ◆₉₂ to a; otherwise if a < 2, apply ♠₂ to a; otherwise compute a ♣₃₇ 2.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 6，对 a 应用 ◆₉₂；否则若 a < 2，对 a 应用 ♠₂；否则对 a 和 2 应用 ♣₃₇。

operators.name: ▽₉₈
operators.definition: a ▽₉₈ b = { b ○₄₇ a, if a >= 6 and b < 7; b ●₇₅ 4, if a < 2 and b >= 10; □₈₁ 1, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b < 7, compute b ○₄₇ a; otherwise if a < 2 and b ≥ 10, compute b ●₇₅ 4; otherwise apply □₈₁ to 1.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 6 且 b < 7，对 b 和 a 应用 ○₄₇；否则若 a < 2 且 b ≥ 10，对 b 和 4 应用 ●₇₅；否则对 1 应用 □₈₁。

operators.name: ▽₉₉
operators.definition: a ▽₉₉ b = { b ◇₂₆ b, if a < 1 and b >= 11; a ♥₉₁, if a < 1 and b >= 1 and b < 11; 2 ▽₈₇ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1 and b ≥ 11, compute b ◇₂₆ b; otherwise if a < 1 and b ≥ 1 and b < 11, apply ♥₉₁ to a; otherwise compute 2 ▽₈₇ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 11，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₂₆；否则若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 1 且 b < 11，对 a 应用 ♥₉₁；否则对 2 和 a 应用 ▽₈₇。

operators.name: ♤₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♤₁₀₀ b = { (b ☆₉₄ 7) ○₂₁, if a >= 8 and b < 1; (a ●₇₀) ♥₈₂ (♣₁₄ b), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 8 and b < 1, apply ☆₉₄ to b and 7, then apply ○₂₁ to the result; otherwise apply ●₇₀ to a, then apply ♥₈₂ to the result and (♣₁₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 8 且 b < 1，先对 b 和 7 应用 ☆₉₄，再对结果应用 ○₂₁；否则先对 a 应用 ●₇₀，再对结果和 ♣₁₄ b 应用 ♥₈₂。
